name: Outreach CRM — Priority Daily Digest
description: Runs every weekday at 8am. Reads Google Sheets, segments leads by priority tier (HOT/WARM/COOL), and emails you a ranked digest of who to contact today. Does NOT send outreach emails.

nodes.name: Email Digest to Yourself
nodes.notes: Sends only to YOU. This workflow never contacts leads.

meta.note: v2 — now sorts by Priority Tier (HOT first), surfaces new HOT leads never emailed, uses updated column schema from crm-setup.md v2.
